input.quote: For the acceptance period and for a period of one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date, and thereafter for as long as the Software is covered by Maintenance Services and is used by Sparkling in accordance with this Agreement, Garman warrants that the Software shall perform in conformance with the Specifications in all material respects.
input.rationale: Section 12 gives a genuine software conformance warranty (Software to perform in conformance with the Specifications) for the acceptance period plus one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date, which satisfies (and exceeds) the fallback 90-day software element. However, the Agreement contains no warranty at all for the services Garman performs (installation, training, Maintenance Services) and no warranty remedy: the only refund is the return of amounts paid on rejection during the acceptance period (Section 8(b)), and the Software Repair Service in Section 10(c) is a best-efforts maintenance obligation conditioned on the support agreement rather than a warranty remedy. There is no disclaimer, so this is not walk-away territory, but the clause fails the fallback on the services warranty and the refund remedy. We therefore insert a 30-day services warranty and a repair/replace-or-refund remedy at fallback level, leaving the existing software warranty period untouched.

proposal.summary: Add a 30-day services warranty and a repair/replace-or-refund warranty remedy in Section 12.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 12 already warrants the Software against the Specifications for over a year, but there is no warranty for the services and no stated warranty remedy, so we have added a 30-day services warranty and a repair, replacement or refund remedy at our fallback position.

ops.text: Garman further warrants that the services provided under this Agreement, including the Maintenance Services, shall be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner for a period of 30 days following their performance. For breach of the warranties in this Section 12, Garman shall repair or replace the non-conforming Software or services or refund the fees paid for the non-conforming Software or services.
